layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: cheerful sugary confectionery, bright, glossy and silly. layers.text: Subject: Rock Candy Golem, a huge towering chunky golem built of big angular rock-candy sugar crystals, far taller than a soldier: a broad body, huge shoulders and thick arms and legs made of big faceted crystal chunks of glossy cotton-candy pink and marshmallow white sugar with hard white highlights, held together by thick bands of warm caramel brown dripping at the joints; a small blocky crystal head set low between the shoulders with two round black dot eyes and a straight caramel mouth; two huge crystal fists hanging low; a few sharp crystal points on its shoulders and back; wide and towering; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
The golem is drawn large and fills most of the image.
